description: Create a document with the options of the New Document dialog (File > New > Document): start from a document preset, set the intent (Print / Web / Mobile preset category), ruler units, page size, pages, facing pages, Start #, primary text frame, columns and gutter, margins (or one value for all sides), bleed and slug, and optionally save the settings as a document preset. With no options it makes a new default document without the dialog

margin.description: One margin for all four sides, mm ("Make all settings the same"); not together with top/bottom/left/right

preset.description: Document preset to start from, e.g. "[Default]" or a saved preset name

savePreset.description: Save these settings as a new document preset with this name (Save Document Preset)

settings.description: New Document / Document Preset settings, by object-model name (DocumentPreset); measurements in mm

createPrimaryTextFrame.description: Primary Text Frame on the parent page

documentBleedUniformSize.description: Use the same bleed on every side

documentSlugUniformSize.description: Use the same slug on every side

intent.description: Intent: the Print / Web / Mobile preset category

left.description: Left (inside, with facing pages) margin, mm

right.description: Right (outside, with facing pages) margin, mm

units.description: Ruler units for the new document (horizontal and vertical)

name: create_document_with_options
title: Create Document With Options
